summary: A content platform with post publishing features. Adding draft/autosave functionality including autosave every 30 seconds, a separate 'Mina utkast' (My Drafts) section, manual save-as-draft button, and a three-option dialog (Delete/Save as Draft/Cancel) when unpublishing a post.

existing_features.title: In the Create Post page (CreatePostPage.tsx), implement autosave every 30 seconds while the user is actively editing. When any field (title, author, content, category) has non-empty content, the form should automatically save/update a draft in the backend. Show a subtle 'Draft saved' indicator near the form after each successful autosave.

Add a 'Save as Draft' button to the Create Post page form (CreatePostPage.tsx), positioned near the existing 'Skapa inlägg' submit button. Clicking it immediately saves the current form state as a draft in the backend and navigates the user to the 'My Drafts' section.

Create a separate 'My Drafts' page or clearly delineated section accessible from the main navigation (for authenticated users). It should list all of the current user's draft posts, showing title, last saved timestamp, and a brief content preview. Each draft card must have three actions: 'Edit' (loads draft into the edit form), 'Publish' (publishes it immediately), and 'Delete' (removes the draft with a confirmation prompt).

When a user disables the 'Publicera omedelbart' (Publish immediately) toggle on an already-published post (visible in CreatePostPage and EditPostPage), show a confirmation dialog with three options: 'Delete permanently' (deletes the post entirely), 'Save as Draft' (converts the post to draft status), and 'Cancel' (dismisses the dialog and keeps the toggle enabled/post published). The toggle should not change state until the user makes a selection.

Add React Query hooks in useQueries.ts for the new draft-related backend calls: saveDraft, updateDraft, getDraftsByUser, and deleteDraft (or reuse deletePost). Ensure query cache for drafts is properly invalidated after any mutation.

new_feature_requests.summary: Autosave posts as drafts every 30 seconds while writing
Manual 'Spara som utkast' (Save as Draft) button in the post form
Separate 'Mina utkast' (My Drafts) section for viewing, editing, and publishing saved drafts
Three-option dialog (Radera helt / Spara som utkast / Avbryt) when disabling 'Publicera omedelbart' on a published post

Add a 'draft' status to the backend post data model so posts can be saved as drafts (not publicly visible). Drafts must be stored persistently per user and retrievable via a dedicated query that returns only the caller's own drafts.

Add backend support for saving and updating a post as a draft, including a saveDraft mutation that accepts the same fields as createPost and returns the draft post ID, and an updateDraft mutation for updating existing drafts.
